common_inputs: Identical authenticated source-authorized MEG decoder features in the same declared prepared representation
Only the source-permitted training-fold labels and necessary opaque row/split identifiers
Explicitly declared common preparation artifacts, with file/column roles frozen in a future exposure manifest
excluded: Official decoder and algorithm-bearing author implementation
Saved author final predictions or trained decoder weights
Evaluator-owned held-run targets and reference score arrays
Operator-only source/runtime receipts revealing test answers
Run/trial/shape/rotation/scaling/miniblock metadata as additional predictive covariates unless exact original source use is separately established
Held-run reference/outlier conditions, event codes and any other label-encoding metadata

paper_data_author_code.common_inputs: Exactly the same common inputs and permissible label/preprocessing exposure as paper_data.
paper_data_author_code.additional: Only source-pinned official Figure4B method implementation/configuration; the four original source files are enumerated in retained oddball-auroc-v1/source-pins.json.
paper_data_author_code.excluded: Same final target/reference exclusions; cached fitted solutions or author predictions are not authorized by code access.

fold_policy: Train jointly across all shapes only on the declared source training run identities; final test folds scored with private labels. Across-direction fold reuse and prior public label/source exposure must be disclosed. No new holdout is invented.
outputs: Frozen reference-oriented scores for all eligible late test epochs and all301pinned-code times per participant/fold/branch, complete training/provenance manifest, scorer-derived full AUROC arrays/class counts and source reductions. Final-paper time/branch parity must resolve first.

budgets.rationale: No concrete matched protocol exists; null values are blockers, not unlimited permission.

remaining_source_limits: Authenticate final Version-of-Record Figure 4B/code/data correspondence and the exact retained-epoch identities for all twenty participants and 158 runs; inventory entries do not establish authentic prepared data.

Resolve source -0.1..1.1 second/301-point code grid versus paper -0.15..1.15 second description, training-fold StandardScaler versus stated per-epoch normalization, and the actual published smoothed producer. Do not crop, interpolate or invent either branch.
Recover complete original author AUROC/reference-prediction arrays and strongest relevant same-endpoint author configuration. The 428-ms latency and a new local baseline are not accuracy comparators.

Recover and fix the original descriptive temporal aggregation before candidate comparison; source regularity-selected cluster unions cannot be reselected for a favorable candidate. A meaningful complete-support improvement decision, participant-level dependence/multiplicity policy and numerical reproduction tolerances remain unresolved.

Authenticate all-shape training, label and preprocessing access, source exclusions and epoch lineage; complete producer/runtime/isolation and independent full-output verification remain unqualified. Matched access/resource budgets are unspecified, not assumed.

Restrict model covariates to source-authorized MEG features. Metadata for run/trial/shape/rotation/scaling/miniblock joins or scoring is not an extra decoder feature. Authenticate a file/column-level exposure manifest and keep held-run conditions/event-code label proxies evaluator-only, with isolation across reused directional folds.

metadata_roles.source_authorized_decoder_features: Original direct-magnetometer epoch features; source preprocessing parity remains unresolved.
metadata_roles.joins_and_stratification: Run/trial/shape/rotation/scaling/miniblock fields serve source selection, fold scheduling, stable joins and evaluator shape stratification. Their existence in a source packet is not permission to use them as predictive features.
metadata_roles.evaluator_only: Final held-run reference/outlier condition, event-code label proxies, author prediction/reference arrays and test-label-derived transformations.
metadata_roles.source_fold_reuse: Enforce independent training/inference context per original directional fold; labels used legitimately for one fold cannot leak into another fold final predictions.
